description: §42.4 statement 10: an unresolved operand of a condition's `!` / `&&` is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN, once per operand.
rationale: §42.4 statement 10: "Inside a condition … an operand of `!`, `&&` or `||` whose type the compiler cannot resolve SHALL be compile error **E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN**". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a on F2, go" (extends S460 "a′, go" from the bare condition to the operands of its `!` / `&&` / `||` chain).
